carpet.rule.TppFakePlayer.name: Fake Player Pearl Station TP
carpet.rule.TppFakePlayer.desc: Use fake players for quick pearl teleport stations. When true, enables /tppset setup command and /tpp player command
carpet.rule.fakePlayerNameSuggestions.de: Customize fake player list suggested by /player command. Use ',' to separate each name
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSkinMode.name: Fake Player Skin Mode
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSkinMode.desc: After installing the skinrestorer dependency, you can set the skin of fake players. default=no change to fake player skin, summon=fake player uses the summoner's skin, same_skin=fake player uses a unified skin
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSkinSet.name: Fake Player Uniform Skin
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSkinSet.desc: When fakePlayerSkinMode is same_skin, set the player name used for fake player skins
carpet.rule.FixXaeroLib.name: XaeroLib Compatibility Patch
carpet.rule.FixXaeroLib.desc: Fix fake player data loss issue with newer Xaero versions when used with LuckPerms
carpet.rule.FixBluemap.name: BlueMap Compatibility Patch
carpet.rule.FixBluemap.desc: Fix fake players not triggering Fabric API connection events, causing mods like BlueMap to fail tracking fake player join/leave
carpet.rule.invisibleInTallGrass.name: Invisible in Tall Grass
carpet.rule.invisibleInTallGrass.desc: Players become invisible when their head is in tall grass
carpet.rule.playerhat.name: Player Hat
carpet.rule.playerhat.desc: Allow players to wear items on their head, adds /hat command. Totem of Undying on head can trigger death protection
carpet.rule.ridingPlayers.name: Riding Players
carpet.rule.ridingPlayers.desc: When holding Totem of Undying in main hand, can ride other players
carpet.rule.pickupPlayers.name: Pickup Players
carpet.rule.pickupPlayers.desc: When holding Totem of Undying in main hand + Golden Carrot in offhand, can pick up other players (let them ride on you)
carpet.rule.ridingPlayersPickUpLimit.des: Maximum number of players that can be stacked when riding or picking up (shared limit)
carpet.rule.ridingPlayersDismountOnGameM: When the player's game mode changes, dismount passengers on head
carpet.rule.ridingPlayersClientAllowInte: Client-side required: allows interacting with blocks/entities while having passengers on head
carpet.rule.sleepingDuringTheDay.name: Daydream
carpet.rule.sleepingDuringTheDay.desc: Allow players to sleep during the day, switches to night after sleeping (referenced from PCA)
carpet.rule.unicodeArgumentsSupport.name: Unicode Argument Support
carpet.rule.unicodeArgumentsSupport.desc: Allow non-ASCII characters (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, etc.) in command arguments, can be used to summon fake players with Chinese names (ported from YACA)
carpet.rule.betterSnowBall.name: Better Snowball
carpet.rule.betterSnowBall.desc: Stone hidden in snow. Allows snowballs to deal knockback and damage to players
carpet.rule.fakePlayerDropStackModifiers: Adds an independent dropall sub-command to /player <name>, letting fake players drop all inventory items at a configured pace. Command: /player <name> dropall [once|continuous|interval <ticks>|after <ticks>|perTick <times>|randomly <min> <max>|stop]
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSendto.name: Fake Player Inventory Link
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSendto.desc: Adds an independent sendto sub-command to /player <name>, creating one-way inventory item flow links between fake players (transfers one stack per trigger, default one stack per tick, round-robin across targets, source buffers when a target is full). Command: /player <name> sendto <target> (create link and start transferring), /player <name> sendto once|continuous|interval <ticks>|after <ticks>|perTick <times>|randomly <min> <max> (adjust pace), /player <name> sendto stop (stop and remove all links). Links are memory-only and lost on fake player logout or server restart
carpet.rule.playerScale.name: Player Scale
carpet.rule.playerScale.desc: Registers minecraft:scale attribute for Player and adds /scale set/reset/info command (value only needs to be greater than 0, with no fixed bounds; display on vanilla clients is still clamped beyond the vanilla attribute range 0.0625–16), and compensates the scaling-induced FOV change (client-side install required). false=disable; self=everyone can only adjust themselves (even OPs); true=players adjust self only, admins adjust anyone; everyone=any player can adjust anyone. Only supported on 1.21.5+
carpet.rule.playerScaleMin.name: Player Scale Min
carpet.rule.playerScaleMin.desc: Minimum scale value all players can set via /scale set; admins can adjust the bound by changing this rule
carpet.rule.playerScaleMax.name: Player Scale Max
carpet.rule.playerScaleMax.desc: Maximum scale value all players can set via /scale set; admins can adjust the bound by changing this rule
carpet.rule.realisticPlayerScale.name: Realistic Player Scale
carpet.rule.realisticPlayerScale.desc: Physics scale with size (minecraft:scale), four modes: false=off; true=gentle, movement/flying/elytra-firework speed, jump, step height, interaction ranges and safe fall distance all scale with the square root of size (no floors); safety=gentle+floors (recommended), adds small-size floors on top of true (speed/gravity 0.3x, jump/step/interaction/fall 0.5x) so tiny sizes stay playable; strict=strictly proportional, all speeds, step height, interaction ranges and safe fall distance scale exactly with size and jump height stays proportional to size (jump strength x scale^0.75), no floors. Gravity always scales with the square root (larger players fall faster). FOV compensation belongs to the playerScale rule (since v1.1.8). Requires the playerScale rule to adjust size. Only supported on 1.21.5+
carpet.rule.playerScaleLinkedEntities.de: Living entities spawned directly by a player using an item inherit the player's current size (stored as a minecraft:scale base-value snapshot): a 0.5x player places 0.5x armor stands; spawn-egg mobs and built iron/snow/copper golems are sized the same way (existing modifiers such as babies stack on top proportionally). Only covers living entities that have the scale attribute; projectiles, dropped items, item frames, boats, minecarts, TNT and other non-living entities are not linked; dispenser/spawner sources are not linked; players at size 1.0 are never modified. Only supported on 1.21.5+
carpet.rule.peacefulPlayers.name: Peaceful Players
carpet.rule.peacefulPlayers.desc: Enables the /pvp command to toggle PVP per player: players with PVP disabled cannot attack players and take no damage from players (self-inflicted damage is unaffected). Commands: /pvp (view your own status), /pvp list (list all players with PVP disabled), /pvp set <player|@a> <on|off>. false=hide; self=everyone can only adjust themselves (even OPs); true=players adjust self only, admins adjust anyone; everyone=any player can adjust anyone. Player states persist across restarts
